info.title: Simplybook API
info.description: This API requires two authentication headers: X-Company-Login and X-Token. The X-Company-Login contains the company identifier and X-Token contains the authentication token received from the /admin/auth endpoint.

example1.description: Include both headers with every request

post.description:
Authentication process. Return auth token info (TokenEntity)
Accepts AdminLoginEntity data as body of request.
Throws BadRequest error in case invalid data was provided with detailed errors per field.

You can use either user password or API User Key for authentication:
- "password": "" - traditional password authentication (requires 2FA and IP verification if enabled)
- "password": "api_user_key_..." - API User Key authentication (bypasses IP verification)

API User Keys can be generated in Settings > API User Keys section.
They are more secure as they allow separate keys per application and don't require sharing your password. **Return Description:** Response data

Authenticate via an OpenID provider (e.g. Google, Facebook) and receive an auth token.
Verify the provider token, resolve the linked company, and return TokenEntity.
If multiple companies are linked to the account and no login is specified,
returns 422 with the list of available company logins so the client can choose.
Accepts AdminOpenidLoginEntity data as body of request. **Return Description:** Response data

Id of the membership this profile was created for. Memberships are the only client-facing
feature that creates recurring profiles today, so this is effectively always set; null
only if the initial invoice unexpectedly has no membership line

init_invoice.description:
Initial invoice. Always built internally (needed to derive client_id/payment_processor
regardless of includes), but only present in the response when requested via
?include=init_invoice - use it to see the full purchase (all lines, amounts, tax) rather
than just the one membership this profile was created for

membership.description:
The membership this profile was created for - the linked entity for membership_id above.
Exactly one membership line is expected on the initial invoice (a client can not buy two
different memberships in one recurring-enabling purchase); null if the invoice
unexpectedly has none. Only present in the response when requested via ?include=membership

days.description:
Repeat days. For 'fixed' type: interval in days between bookings (e.g. 7 = every 7 days).
For 'weekly' type: bitmask of week days. Sum the values for the days you need:
Sunday=1, Saturday=2, Friday=4, Thursday=8, Wednesday=16, Tuesday=32, Monday=64.
Example: Monday+Wednesday = 64+16 = 80.

type.description:
Type of repeat. Can be 'fixed', 'weekly'
'weekly' means repeat every week day, that set in $days mask.
'fixed' means repeat every $days day.

mode.description:
Mode when it is impossible to book appointment on some date. Can be: 'skip', 'book_available', 'book_and_move'.
'skip' - Skip all bookings
'book_available' - book only on available dates
'book_and_move' - move to next date in case some date is not available

price_per_session.description:
Price per session flag
If true, the price is per session, otherwise it is per whole pack
